claim_scope: All strictly positive relaxation, run-termination and rest-termination rates and active speed; one-dimensional stationary position without thermal translation noise.
scientific_integrity: The full generator proof is provided and exact-rational checks corroborate it. Published prior moment and density formulas, along with their qualitative central and boundary transitions, are explicitly acknowledged. Independent review is pending.
scientific_limitations: Earlier research already determines the full one-time marginal at fixed rates. This contribution is the positive two-beta factorization, simultaneous stochastic parameter coupling, strict all-tail ordering and exact general-rate localization amplitudes. General marginal-to-beta transformations might imply an earlier unlocated equivalent. No trajectory-wise ordering, noisy measurement reconstruction, or independent priority certification is claimed.
title: Beta-product coupling and sharp stationary confinement laws for a run–stop–run particle
